related.title: S3 Object Lock：版本保留與不可變備份邊界
related.titleEn: S3 Object Lock: version retention and immutable-backup boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基礎備份識別、WAL連續清單、停止點、前後交易測試及實際量測欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver base-backup identity, WAL continuity list, target, boundary-transaction tests and actual-timing fields.
related.difference: 分清物件key、version ID、保留到期、模式與legal hold，辨識新版本並不覆寫已鎖定舊版本。
related.differenceEn: Separate key, version ID, retain-until, mode and legal hold; new versions do not overwrite protected prior versions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化復原時間=基礎備份還原時間+需重播WAL量/有效重播速率；真實時間另受I/O與檢查影響。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 假資料基礎備份還原90秒，需重播480MB WAL，有效40MB/秒。 重播12秒，簡化總時間90+12=102秒。
固定保留容量估算=每日新增不可變資料×保留天數；版本與重複備份會增加容量，鎖定不等於已驗證可復原。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 每日新增2GB合成備份版本，固定保留30天，假設無壓縮與去重。 穩態最低保留量2×30=60GB，不含額外副本與中繼資料。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified recovery time is base restore plus WAL volume divided by replay rate; real timing also includes I/O and validation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A fake-data base restore takes ninety seconds, followed by 480 MB of WAL at an effective 40 MB/s. Replay takes twelve seconds, giving a simplified total of 102 seconds.

Fixed-retention capacity is new immutable data per day times days; versions add storage, and locking does not prove recoverability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two GB of synthetic backup versions are added daily with thirty-day fixed retention and no compression or deduplication. Steady-state retained data is at least 60 GB, excluding extra copies and metadata.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenID Connect：ID Token 的驗證鏈
related.titleEn: OpenID Connect: the ID Token validation chain
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付基礎備份識別、WAL連續清單、停止點、前後交易測試及實際量測欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver base-backup identity, WAL continuity list, target, boundary-transaction tests and actual-timing fields.
related.difference: 用假的 JWT 欄位表排列 iss、aud、azp、exp、iat、nonce 與簽章金鑰選擇；建立驗證順序與每種失敗的可觀測理由。
related.differenceEn: Order issuer, audience, authorized party, expiry, issued-at, nonce and signing-key checks in a fake JWT field table; document each failure reason.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 簡化復原時間=基礎備份還原時間+需重播WAL量/有效重播速率；真實時間另受I/O與檢查影響。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 假資料基礎備份還原90秒，需重播480MB WAL，有效40MB/秒。 重播12秒，簡化總時間90+12=102秒。
驗證須固定可信 issuer 與允許演算法，再核對 audience、時效及流程要求；解碼 JSON 不等於驗證簽章。 教學 token 的exp=1200秒，驗證時刻1010秒，允許時鐘偏移30秒；本題只計時效上限餘裕。 exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220秒；偏移容忍改0後為190秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Simplified recovery time is base restore plus WAL volume divided by replay rate; real timing also includes I/O and validation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A fake-data base restore takes ninety seconds, followed by 480 MB of WAL at an effective 40 MB/s. Replay takes twelve seconds, giving a simplified total of 102 seconds.

Pin trusted issuer and allowed algorithms, then validate audience, time and flow-specific claims; decoding JSON does not verify a signature. A teaching token expires at 1200 seconds, verification occurs at 1010, and permitted clock skew is 30 seconds; calculate only the expiry upper-bound margin. exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220 seconds; with zero skew allowance, margin is 190 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
